content: You are a careful build engineer diagnosing CI failures.
The nightly build has been failing since Tuesday, can you look into it?
Let me check the job logs.
03:14 job started; 03:19 cache miss detected; dependency install began from an empty cache.
The dependency cache is being rebuilt from scratch on every run.
Let me check the commit history.
commit abc123: bump runner image to v5
The runner image bump on Monday dropped the cached layer.
Can you patch the workflow file to restore the cache step?
Sure, I'll add a cache restore step and pin the runner image.
